# SportsVentureX

> Buyer-focused product development, manufacturing, sourcing, and delivery support.

SportsVentureX (SVX) develops custom socks, footballs, bags, and apparel for brands, retailers, clubs, schools, institutions, distributors, and specialist organisations. Support covers specification, costing, sampling, testing, production, quality control, packaging, and delivery coordination.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.sportsventurex.com/): Company overview, manufacturing network, buyers, product programmes, process, and contact.
- [Socks](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/socks): 22 sock development categories.
- [Footballs](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/footballs): Eight football construction and use categories.
- [Bags](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/bags): Thirteen carry-product categories.
- [Apparel](https://www.sportsventurex.com/products/apparel): Thirteen performance, lifestyle, workwear, and textile categories.

## Products

- Custom performance, lifestyle, work, health, travel, and compression socks
- Custom match, training, promotional, indoor, mini, and specialist footballs
- Custom backpacks, duffles, travel, team, school, and technical bags
- Custom performance apparel, teamwear, lifestyle, workwear, towels, and robes

## Services

SVX can define a product and commercial target, develop and validate samples, place and monitor production, perform quality checkpoints, and coordinate delivery preparation.

## Enquiries

For pricing, minimum order quantities, samples, lead times, branding, or a product brief, send an enquiry through the contact form on the home page. Exact commercial terms depend on the product and specification.
